arguments.command:
export DRIVE_SESSION_TAG=nothingness_seek_linux; export DRIVE_TARGET=linux; export DRIVE_RUN_LOG=/tmp/flutter_run_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}.log; export DRIVE_FLUTTER_FIFO=/tmp/flutter_input_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}; export DRIVE_DESKTOP_HOME=/tmp/nothingness_${DRIVE_SESSION_TAG}; .claude/skills/agent-emulator-debugging/scripts/drive.py call ext.nothingness.getPlaybackState > /tmp/pstate.json && python3 - <<'PY'
import json
with open('/tmp/pstate.json') as f:
  data=json.load(f)
si=data.get('songInfo')
print('isPlaying',data.get('isPlaying'))
if si: print('position',si.get('position'),'duration',si.get('duration'))
PY
